title: 第7章 触发隐藏任务第8章 灵宠富贵
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
山林间飘散着淡淡的灵气，并不算浓郁，像是被人吃剩的残羹剩饭，但对于她这个筑基期的菜鸡来说，已经够用了。
灵力顺着经脉缓缓流转，温养着她的四肢百骸。
之前那些疲惫和酸痛在灵力的冲刷下渐渐消散，取而代之的是一种久违的轻松感。
自从她死过一次后，这具新身体还是第一次正儿八经的修炼。
两个时辰后，宁楚睁开眼，眼睛里闪过一丝惊喜。
她发现这具身体的修炼天赋比原来那具身体强了不止五倍。
以前修炼就像是用一根吸管喝粥，费半天劲只能喝到一点点。
现在这个身体，像是直接把碗端起来往嘴里倒。
她高兴得手舞足蹈，抬手按了按胸口，或许，是五彩石的功劳。
宁楚现在精神焕发，整个人像是充了电一样，浑身都是劲儿。
她在山洞里转了两圈，活动了一下筋骨，觉得这个婆山洞都顺眼了不少。
心情好了，才有闲心问正事。
她一屁股坐回毯子上，双手撑在身后，翘着二郎腿，晃着脚丫子，一副悠然自得的样子，“统统，问你个事。”
【系统：说。】
“我的任务没完成，身体也死了，你不是应该跟脱离了吗？为什么还在？”
“难道是舍不得我？还是你要我继续攻略鹤隐舟？”
要她继续攻略鹤隐舟那是不可能的。
【系统：你可真会想。】
【系统：因为宿主死遁的骚操作，任务更新为清除鹤隐舟黑化值，助他渡劫飞升。触发隐藏任务，成为浮生界剑修第一。奖励翻三倍。】
宁楚整个人像被雷劈中了一样，僵在原地，一动不动。

她的眼睛瞪得圆圆的，表情从震惊变成茫然，从茫然变成荒唐，最后定格在一种你是不是在逗我的崩溃上。
系统要她一个筑基登顶剑修第一，是在耍她吗。
现在浮生界的最强剑修是鹤隐舟，系统一边要她感化他，一边要她抢夺他的剑修第一。
左右脑互搏。
再说了，她的本命剑当初忘在了天剑宗，现在修为不够，根本召唤不了，怎么练，拿什么练。
“如果，我是说如果，这两个任务都完不成的话会有什么惩罚吗？”
【系统：稍等，其他小世界有点波动，我去看一眼，回来再回答你的问题。】
电子音消失，宁楚脑子的系统就再也没了动静。
她等了一会儿，没等到它回来，干脆站起身来，随手捡了根树枝，摆了个剑修的起手式。
姿势很标准，是天剑宗入门剑法的起手式。
但她手里拿的不是剑，是一根树枝。
宁楚低头看了看手里的树枝，又看了看自己微微隆起的小腹，嘴角抽了抽。
“……算了，明天再练。”
她把树枝往旁边一扔，重新躺回毯子上，拉过旧毯子把自己裹成一个茧。
翌日一早，宁楚早早出发，走了大约半个时辰，前方出现了一个镇子。
镇子不大，但烟火气很足，远远就能闻到包子铺的蒸汽味和面摊上的葱花香。
她的肚子立刻叫了起来，声音大得像打雷。
“先吃饭，吃完饭再跑。”她理直气壮地给自己找了个借口，“饿着肚子跑不快，被逮到就是死路一条，吃饱了至少死之前是个饱死鬼。”
刚进镇口，她就觉得不对劲。
content_en:
There was a faint spiritual energy floating in the mountains and forests. It was not strong, like leftovers from someone's food, but it was enough for a novice like her in the foundation building stage.
The spiritual power slowly flowed along the meridians, warming her limbs and bones.
The fatigue and soreness before gradually dissipated under the wash of spiritual power, replaced by a long-lost sense of relaxation.
Since she died once, this new body is the first time for serious training.
Two hours later, Ning Chu opened his eyes, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes.
She discovered that this body's cultivation talent was more than five times stronger than the original body.
In the past, practicing cultivation was like drinking porridge with a straw. After a long time of effort, you could only get a little bit.
This body now seems to be directly picking up the bowl and pouring it into the mouth.
She danced with joy and raised her hand to press her chest. Perhaps it was the work of the colorful stones.
Ning Chu was now full of energy, as if his whole body was recharged and full of energy.
She walked around the cave twice and stretched her muscles. She felt that Poshan Cave was quite pleasing to the eye.
When you are in a good mood, you can have time to ask about serious matters.
She sat back on the blanket, put her hands behind her, crossed her legs, and swayed her feet, looking leisurely and contented, "Tongtong, I want to ask you something."
[System: Say. 】
"My mission has not been completed and my body is dead. Shouldn't you leave? Why are you still here?"
"Are you reluctant to leave me? Or do you want me to continue attacking Heyinzhou?"
It was impossible for her to continue to attack He Yinzhou.
[System: You really think about it. 】
[System: Due to the host’s arrogant operation in escaping, the mission has been updated to clear He Yinzhou’s blackened value and help him overcome the calamity and ascend. Trigger the hidden mission and become the number one swordsman in the world of floating life. Rewards tripled. 】
Ning Chu's whole body seemed to be struck by lightning, frozen on the spot, motionless.
Her eyes were round, and her expression changed from shock to confusion, from confusion to absurdity, and finally settled on a "are you kidding me" breakdown.
The system wants her to build a foundation and reach the top of swordsmanship. Is it kidding her?
Currently, the strongest swordsman in the floating world is He Yinzhou. The system wants her to influence him, and at the same time, it wants her to take away his first place in swordsmanship.
The left and right brains fight each other.
Besides, her natal sword was forgotten in Tianjian Sect. Now she is not cultivated enough and cannot summon it at all. How to practice it and what to use to practice it.
"If, I mean if, these two tasks cannot be completed, will there be any punishment?"
[System: Wait a moment, other small worlds are a bit unstable. I'll take a look and come back to answer your question. 】
The electronic sound disappeared, and the system in Ning Chu's brain stopped moving.
She waited for a while, but didn't wait for it to come back. She simply stood up, picked up a branch, and made a sword cultivator's starting position.
The posture is very standard, it is the starting position of Tianjian Sect's introductory swordsmanship.
But what she held in her hand was not a sword, but a branch.
Ning Chu looked down at the branch in his hand, then at his slightly bulging belly, and the corners of his mouth twitched.
"...Forget it, we'll practice again tomorrow."
She tossed the branch aside, lay back on the blanket, and pulled the old blanket over herself into a cocoon.
The next morning, Ning Chu set off early. After walking for about half an hour, a town appeared in front of him.
The town is not big, but the smoke from the fireworks is very strong. You can smell the steam from the bun shop and the aroma of chopped green onion from the noodle stall from a distance.
Her stomach immediately growled, as loud as thunder.
"Eat first, then run after eating." She confidently made an excuse for herself, "You can't run fast if you are hungry, and you will die if you are caught. If you are full, at least you will be full before you die."
As soon as she entered the town, she felt something was wrong.
